# tenferro v0.10.0

The 0.10.0 crates on crates.io were built from `fd5fc73de6`. This note is not an
inventory of that tree: it records the single entry `CHANGELOG.md` holds for it
— traced values are owned by a `TraceContext` — plus the following two
user-visible outcomes that the changelog does not list and that
`git diff v0.9.0 v0.10.0` shows in the same tree. Every entry after the 0.10.0
section in `CHANGELOG.md` describes a change made on `main` after the published
commit, and ships in v0.11.0 rather than here.

## Breaking changes

### Traced values are owned by a `TraceContext`

`TracedTensor` no longer carries its own graph, so the context-free
constructors, `TracedTensor::graph()` and the public `id` / `rank` / `dtype` /
`val` fields are gone. See
[`docs/design/traced-over-trace-context.md`](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/blob/v0.10.0/docs/design/traced-over-trace-context.md)
§3.9 for the complete list and
[`docs/guides/custom-operations.md`](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/blob/v0.10.0/docs/guides/custom-operations.md#migrating-a-context-free-constructor)
for the one-line shape of the migration.

- Extension authors: `TracedTensor::input_concrete_shape(dtype, shape)` becomes
  `<ctx>.input_concrete_shape(dtype, shape)`, and a traced value can only be
  combined with values from the same context.
- `GraphCompiler::compile_many` requires at least one output; a zero-output
  program is built with `SemanticProgramBuilder::finish(&[])`.
- AD seeds of an externally defined scalar must carry that scalar's canonical
  identity, which the context constructors now supply.

## Improvements

- `tenferro_linalg::normalize_eig_vectors` is public
  ([#2387](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/issues/2387)). It
  normalizes the eigenvector columns of a batch of `n x n` column-major blocks
  in place to the unit 2-norm gauge `eig` documents, scales each column by its
  largest component before summing the squares, and reports a column that has no
  unit gauge as the same `Error::NonFinite` with `op: "eig"` that `eig` raises.
  A kernel that drives `tlinalg` eig itself can now produce `eig`'s values and
  `eig`'s typed failure without a copy of the arithmetic. Additive.

## Fixes

- CUDA device discovery returns a typed error instead of unwinding when the
  driver library or one of its entry points is missing
  ([#2401](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/issues/2401)).
  `CudaDriverApi::initialize` asks `t4a_cuda_runtime::device_count()` first, so
  a host without the driver gets `CudaDriverDiscoveryError::DriverUnavailable`
  through the documented `Result` instead of a panic, which is what a binary
  picking a backend at run time needs.

## Dependency migration

The published tree also moves the shared CPU dependencies: `threadteam` 0.3 -> 0.4,
`t4a-faer` 0.28 -> 0.30, and the `strided-*` family 0.10 -> 0.11 (`Cargo.toml`
at `fd5fc73de6`). A consumer that passes these types across the tenferro
boundary has to move with them; this is independent of the `TraceContext`
change above.

**Full comparison:** https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/compare/v0.9.0...v0.10.0
